# SLM Active Brain Context (auto-generated)

_Regenerated by SuperLocalMemory. Content here is supplementary; `AGENTS.md` remains canonical._

## Never do
- Do not modify files under `.slm/`
- Do not commit `*.slm-cache.db`

## Memory protocol
Use the SLM tools via the `slm-hub` MCP gateway so brain context grows across sessions.

- **At the start of work on an unfamiliar area**, call `hub__call_tool` with `tool="slm__recall"` and `arguments={"query": "<topic>"}` to surface prior decisions and patterns.
- **At the end of a substantial task**, call `hub__call_tool` with `tool="slm__remember"` and `arguments={"content": "<one-paragraph summary>", "project": "MindbodyMCP", "tags": "<comma-separated kebab-case keywords>"}`, opening `content` with `[MindbodyMCP]`.
- A "substantial task" is anything you would write a commit message or handoff note about — not every tool call.
